name: Python
description: The most versatile language in the ecosystem. Python powers data science, machine learning, backend systems, automation, and scripting. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python (3rd Ed.)
items.description: The premier beginner resource for learning practical scripting to automate everyday tasks.

items.title: Think Python (3rd Edition)
items.description: Completely redesigned for modern learning. Runs in Jupyter notebooks — read, execute code, and work through exercises directly in the browser.

items.title: Dive Into Python 3
items.description: A free book for experienced programmers to learn Python 3 quickly. Covers native datatypes, comprehensions, closures, generators, and testing.

items.title: The Python Tutorial
items.description: Curated by the core developers and PSF. The definitive resource for understanding the language syntax, standard library, and data structures.

items.title: Python Language Reference
items.description: The complete reference for Python syntax, lexical analysis, data model, execution model, and import system.

items.title: Python Standard Library
items.description: The built-in library reference covering everything from string operations to networking, threading, and web frameworks.

items.title: Google's Python Class
items.description: Free class from Google engineers with lecture videos, written materials, and code exercises covering regex, utilities, and more.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — Python Curriculum
items.description: Completely free, project-based curriculum with browser-based coding environments and certifications for Python.

items.title: Python for Beginners — Full Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A multi-hour comprehensive video tutorial covering core concepts, loops, dictionaries, classes, and mini-projects.

items.title: PyCon US Talks (YouTube)
items.description: Hundreds of free conference talks from Python core contributors, software architects, and library maintainers.

items.title: Exercism — Python Track
items.description: 100% free platform with 146 coding exercises across 17 concepts. Includes automated code analysis and human mentor feedback.

items.title: Codewars
items.description: Master Python by solving bite-sized community-crafted challenges and comparing solutions with other developers.

items.title: HackerRank — Python Track
items.description: Domain-specific challenges from basic I/O to advanced data structures and interview preparation.

items.title: Real Python Cheat Sheet
items.description: Compact, exhaustive reference covering syntax, data types, collections, control flow, functions, and file I/O.

items.title: Python Cheatsheet (devhints)
items.description: A concise one-page reference for Python 3 syntax, built-in functions, comprehensions, and common patterns.

items.title: PyCoder's Weekly
items.description: A premier weekly email newsletter highlighting the best Python articles, tutorials, open-source projects, and community news.

items.title: Python.org — Latest News
items.description: Official Python Software Foundation blog covering release announcements, PEP summaries, and community updates.

items.title: Reddit r/learnpython
items.description: The largest community of Python learners and educators.

items.title: Stack Overflow — Python Tag
items.description: The definitive Q&A forum for Python questions — from beginner syntax to advanced metaprogramming patterns.

items.title: Python Discord
items.description: A large, active Python community on Discord with channels for learning, projects, and career advice.

lessons.title: Getting Started with Python
lessons.description: Install Python, set up a development environment, understand the interpreter, and write your first program.

lessons.title: Variables, Types, and Basic Operations
lessons.description: Python's dynamic type system, primitive types, variables, numbers, strings, and basic operators.

lessons.title: Control Flow: Conditionals and Loops
lessons.description: if/elif/else, for loops, while loops, match statements, and loop control with break/continue.

lessons.title: Functions and Scope
lessons.description: Function definitions, parameters, return values, scope rules, lambda expressions, and function annotations.

lessons.title: Lists, Tuples, and Sequences
lessons.description: List operations, list comprehensions, tuples, slicing, and sequence protocol.

lessons.title: Dictionaries and Sets
lessons.description: Dictionary operations, set theory, hash tables, and when to use each collection type.

lessons.title: Strings, Formatting, and Text Processing
lessons.description: String methods, f-strings, formatting, Unicode, regex basics, and text processing patterns.

lessons.title: File I/O and Exception Handling
lessons.description: Reading/writing files, context managers, try/except/finally, custom exceptions, and structured data persistence.

lessons.title: Modules, Packages, and Virtual Environments
lessons.description: Import system, module creation, packages, virtual environments, and dependency management with pip.

lessons.title: Classes and Object-Oriented Programming
lessons.description: Class definitions, instance management, inheritance, polymorphism, special methods, and dataclasses.

lessons.title: Generators, Iterators, and Context Managers
lessons.description: Iterator protocol, generator functions, yield expressions, generator expressions, and context manager protocols.

lessons.title: Decorators and Closures
lessons.description: Function decorators, decorator factories, class decorators, closures, and practical decorator patterns.

lessons.title: Advanced Functions: Lambdas and Functional Tools
lessons.description: Lambda expressions, map/filter/reduce, functools (partial, lru_cache, wraps), and functional programming patterns.

lessons.title: Regular Expressions
lessons.description: Regex syntax, pattern compilation, groups, lookahead/lookbehind, re module functions, and text processing with regex.

lessons.title: Testing and Debugging
lessons.description: Unittest, pytest, test fixtures, mocking, debugging with pdb, profiling with cProfile, and logging best practices.

lessons.title: Working with Data: JSON, CSV, and APIs
lessons.description: JSON parsing, CSV processing, REST APIs with requests, data validation with pydantic, and data pipeline patterns.

lessons.title: Concurrency with Threading and Multiprocessing
lessons.description: Threading basics, thread safety, the GIL, multiprocessing, process pools, and when to use each concurrency model.

lessons.title: Async/Await and Asyncio
lessons.description: Coroutines, async/await syntax, event loop, tasks, futures, and building async applications with asyncio.

lessons.title: Pythonic Patterns and Idioms
lessons.description: EAFP vs LBYL, duck typing, composition over inheritance, descriptor protocol, property decorator, and SOLID in Python.

lessons.title: Metaprogramming and Advanced Features
lessons.description: Metaclasses, class decorators, __init_subclass__, __set_name__, and dynamic attribute access with __getattr__/__setattr__.

lessons.title: Performance: Profiling, Optimization, and C Extensions
lessons.description: Profiling tools, optimizing hot paths, using C extensions with Cython, Numba, and when to drop down to C.
